# Dubu

## About
Dubu is the first international payment experience built natively for WhatsApp. It lets you send money across borders without downloading any app, creating an account, or navigating complex menus — just chat with Dubu on WhatsApp and money moves. Text it, say it, or snap a photo of an account number and Dubu handles the rest. Recipients receive funds directly to their bank accounts or mobile wallets — they don't need Dubu or any app to receive money.

## How It Works
1. Save our number — add Dubu to your WhatsApp contacts. One number for all your international transfers.
2. Start a chat — say "hi" or send money instructions naturally. Dubu understands what you need.
3. Send globally — money moves instantly to bank accounts or mobile wallets across 50+ countries.

## What You Can Do

### Send money
Type naturally — "Abeg send $100 go Lagos" works. Dubu confirms the rate, the fee, and the recipient before sending. Voice notes and photos of receipts/account numbers are also understood.

### Check rates
Ask for today's rates at any time. Rates lock for 60 seconds when you send — no hidden markups, no surprises. Typically 60–80% cheaper than traditional banks.

### Snap a bill
Send a photo of a bill, invoice, or handwritten account number. Dubu reads it and handles the payment — confirm to send.

### Bill payments
Pay airtime, data, DSTV, electricity, and more — just ask Dubu to handle it.

### Crypto (USDT)
Sell USDT directly to your wallet at live rates without P2P hassle.

## Supported Scenarios
- Family remittances: send to parents, siblings, relatives across borders
- Market payments: snap an account number, Dubu pays it
- Data & airtime top-ups: recharge any network without switching apps
- Salary splitting: describe how to split an incoming payment and Dubu routes it
- Friend transfers: send urgently when banking apps are down
- Crypto off-ramps: sell USDT to NGN at competitive rates

## Pricing
- USD transfers: $1 flat under $300 · $2.50 flat from $300–$1,000 · 0.4% above $1,000
- Typically 60–80% cheaper than traditional banks
- Rates are locked at send time — no mid-transfer changes
- Zero setup cost

## Coverage
- Send from: UK, US, Canada, and major European countries
- Send to: 50+ countries including Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, South Africa, Uganda, Tanzania, India, Philippines, and more
- Supported currencies: USD, NGN, GBP, EUR, and more

## Security & Trust
- 256-bit encryption on all conversations and transactions
- PCI DSS compliant
- Biometric verification
- PIN confirmation per transaction
- Payments processed through Interswitch — Africa's leading payment technology company
- Deposits held in NDIC-insured accounts — same statutory protection as a Nigerian bank deposit
- End-to-end encrypted chats — Dubu only sees the transaction details needed to process your transfer

## Partners & Infrastructure
- Powered by Dubu Business API — the same payment infrastructure trusted by merchants across Africa
- Interswitch & Daya: card and bank transfer processing
- NDIC-insured via Interswitch

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Do recipients need to install Dubu?
A: No. Recipients receive money directly to their bank account or mobile wallet. They don't need any app or account.

Q: Is Dubu available in my country?
A: You can send from the UK, US, Canada, and major European countries to 50+ countries including Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, South Africa, Uganda, Tanzania, India, and the Philippines.

Q: How fast are transfers?
A: Most transfers arrive within minutes. Bank transfers typically complete in 5–30 minutes depending on the destination. You receive real-time updates in your WhatsApp chat.

Q: Is my chat data private?
A: Your conversations are end-to-end encrypted. Dubu only sees the transaction details necessary to process your transfer — never your personal messages.

Q: What are the fees?
A: USD transfers: $1 flat under $300, $2.50 to $1,000, and 0.4% above $1,000. Always shown before you confirm — no hidden fees.

Q: Can I send using voice notes or photos?
A: Yes. Send a voice note with transfer instructions or snap a photo of an account number or bill — Dubu reads it and asks you to confirm before sending.

Q: How do I track my transfer?
A: Ask "Where's my transfer?" in chat and Dubu will give you real-time status. You also receive automatic notifications when money is sent, in transit, and delivered.

Q: What is Dubu built on?
A: Dubu is powered by the Dubu Business API and processes payments through Interswitch. Deposits are held in NDIC-insured accounts.
